purpose: Read-only observed downstream, installed and P1-stack evidence for published107. Core, critical/recovery and V2 detail belong to separate root/peer receipts.

evidence_rules.raw_log_hash_meaning: SHA-256 of the exact complete connector-decoded log string encoded as UTF-8, preserving BOM, CR/LF and terminal newlines; not a ZIP/HTTP-transfer checksum.
evidence_rules.excerpt_hash_meaning: SHA-256 of exact raw excerpt bytes; one-based source log lines. Excerpt excludes the separator after its final line. Original timestamps, ANSI escapes and any CR bytes are preserved.
evidence_rules.metadata_hash_meaning: SHA-256 of the complete returned UTF-8 API JSON; selected parsed metadata are included. No claim that omitted raw metadata were embedded.
evidence_rules.reported_report_hash_meaning: A CI-printed report hash is a reported receipt. Artifact bodies were not downloaded or independently hashed.
evidence_rules.same_tree_boundary: Published PR and observed merge have equal Git trees; merge has PR as a parent. Read test jobs show that checkout. Aggregate-only jobs have no claimed checkout.
evidence_rules.integrity_is_not_quality: Passing oracle controls or report integrity does not replace failing current quality.
evidence_rules.actual_client_boundary: Installed CI used reviewed wheel and deterministic scripted planner. Real Claude, Codex and OpenCode clients were NOT_RUN in this collection.
evidence_rules.selected_raw_json_meaning: P1.5 source receipt retains selected exact raw JSON value spans with line and character/byte offsets, per-fragment hashes and whole raw-line hash. Unselected diagnostics are not embedded.

failed_case.first_loss_observation: Project return contains ARCHITECTURE.md and is deliverable. Unified return retains that source plus exact Tenacity source and is deliverable. Final public/snapshot bindings contain only library source; required ARCHITECTURE.md full fact is absent. This locates loss after the observed unified return, without assigning an unobserved product operand.
failed_case.diagnostic_carrier_warning: same_path_children identity_matches is explicitly based on raw_top_level_lineage_only. It must not be substituted for the real combined library DTO verifier, whose source_errors are empty.

current_delivery.claim_boundary: Frozen bound candidate injection at real handler/projector/MCP serialization boundary; not indexed retrieval, stdio or real model/client evidence.

retained_adversarial.mutation_gate: FAIL: baseline did not pass full trajectory gate; no mutation credit

retrieval.interpretation: Current evidence reports no operational/integrity errors and no holdout regression; bounded causal/selection checks did not observe improvement. No 800-token pass/fail ceiling is reinstated by this receipt.

main_advanced_detail.detail_boundary: Main advanced and V2 quality details are outside this collector ownership. Parent/peer report three failed Transport closed attempts; this receipt does not infer their scores or causal operands.

core_detail.detail_boundary: Parent independently owns JUnit diagnostic receipt; counts and failures are not duplicated here.
